details.method: For a staged database that already contains a complete Git bundle, measure the target database, pack, index, warmup kit and first record-index query together. Compare actual cold-start and adoption peak allocation at Git operation boundaries, and verify original refs, object IDs and file bytes after relocation.
details.when: A published native catalog contains a complete supported Git bundle and deployment disk headroom is constrained during first access.
details.counterexample: WAL-active targets cannot be identified by the database-file hash alone. Partial bundles, unapproved kit digests or different publication scopes must fail before promotion; an NTFS sample is not a Linux storage limit.
details.trial_plan: On a second target filesystem, import the same approved published catalog, keep cold export disabled during first query, cross-check refs and file bytes against the independent mirror, measure allocation and verify wrong-kit rejection and ordinary cold fallback.
